title: Quantification of Ascending Aortic Aneurysms
author: Jing Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.izicf4e

steps.title: Dissect and Fix Aortas
steps.instruction: Cut open the mouse ventrally, perfuse with saline, and dissect the aorta.

substeps.instruction: Place dissected aortas in 4% paraformaldehyde or 10% neutrally buffered formalin for 24-48 hours.
Once fixed, store aortas in saline at room temperature or 2-8 °C.

steps.title: Clean Aortas
steps.instruction: Prepare and clean the aortas to remove adventitial tissues.

substeps.instruction: Allow aortas to soak in saline for a few hours before cleaning.
Remove adventitial tissues, ensuring the aorta and important branches are not torn or nicked.
Use saline to keep the tissue moist during the cleaning process.

steps.title: Prepare Aorta for Imaging
steps.instruction: Cut and pin the aorta to expose the intimal area.

substeps.instruction: Leave 1 mm of innominate and left common carotid artery, and cut off the entire left subclavian artery.
Cut open the outer curvature through the innominate artery, then to the left common carotid artery, and then to the left subclavian artery.
Cut open along the inner curvature of the ascending portion to the bottom of the abdominal portion.
Pin the aorta flat on black wax using pins (Fine Science Tools item # 26002-20).
Apply saline to prevent drying.
Label the mouse number on both the lid and box of the black wax.

steps.title: Capture Aorta Images
steps.instruction: Take pictures of the en face aorta using a Nikon digital camera, ensuring a mm ruler is included in the images for calibration.

steps.title: Calibrate Images in Image Pro
steps.instruction: Perform spatial calibration using Image Pro program 5.0 or 7.0.

substeps.instruction: Open the image and navigate to 'Measure' > 'Calibrate' > 'spacial calibration'.
Select 'spacial calibration wizard' and follow directions, or click 'new' and name the calibration.
Click 'image', position the line over the ruler, and change reference units to mm.
Click 'ok' and then 'apply'.

steps.title: Label and Save Images
steps.instruction: Annotate images in Image Pro 5.0 or 7.0.

substeps.instruction: Click the annotation button (O), select 'Aa', click on the picture, and enter the study name, mouse #, and date.
Click 'ok' and burn the label to the image by pressing the double arrows (bb).
Save the picture and repeat for remaining images.

steps.title: Measure Intimal Area
steps.instruction: Quantify the intimal area of the ascending region using the calibrated software.

substeps.instruction: Select the correct calibration for each image via 'Measure' > 'Calibration' > 'set system' > 'Apply'.
Go to 'measure' menu and select 'measurements'.
Use the polygon button (-) on the Measurement Toolbar to trace the intimal area of the ascending region.

steps.title: Export and Save Data
steps.instruction: Export measurements and save the image files.

substeps.instruction: Go to 'input/output', choose measurements, and click 'export now'.
Paste the data into a spreadsheet.
Save the image via the input/output tab as 'mouse #....msr'.
Print the image with overlay if desired; do not close the image until printing, saving, and recording in the spreadsheet are complete.

steps.title: Verify and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Verify measurements and archive the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Have a second observer, blind to study groups, verify the quantification.
Unpin aortas and place them into properly labeled tubes with saline containing 0.02% sodium azide.
Store tubes at room temperature.
